Definition: Jishi, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ishi = "He saves me"; 1) son of Appaim, one of the line of Jerahmeel of the house of Hezron; 2) a chief of Manasseh and head of a family on the east of Jordan; 3) a chief of Judah, father of Zoheth; 4) a chief of Simeon and head of a family
